prd_items.acceptance: The published artifact serves only registered Bash routing and a real Bash-only runner completes an instruction dispatch without an unregistered pwsh tool-order error.
prd_items.subject: Rustc 1.98.1 is available. Build and run the sibling gm plugkit artifact, then witness an instruction dispatch on a Bash-only tool manifest without any pwsh tool-order emission. Previously marked blockedBy external; that blocker is gone.
prd_items.title: Verify the gm pwsh routing correction through its published artifact

prd_items.acceptance: A live GM instruction response against Freddie provides usable code-insight counts or a documented supported capability state and does not report `counts_error: unknown_plugin`.
prd_items.subject: Diagnose and repair the `codeinsight_overview.counts_error: unknown_plugin` failure reported by a live GM instruction dispatch. Precondition: reproduce against the running published GM path. Invariant: unavailable insight never appears as successful coverage. Postcondition: live instruction responses either report accurate source counts or an explicit supported capability state, without `unknown_plugin`.
prd_items.title: Restore GM code-insight observability

prd_items.acceptance: A live GM Bash dispatch and its served contract agree on whether a bare multiline script needs timeoutMs.
prd_items.subject: Repair the mismatch between GM prose that accepts bare Bash commands and live dispatch that rejects a bare multiline script for missing timeoutMs. Precondition: the published command contract promises bare-command support. Invariant: accepted body grammar and executable parser remain aligned. Postcondition: a bare multiline Bash script succeeds without a timeout prefix, or served documentation explicitly requires the prefix and a live witness confirms it.
prd_items.title: Align GM bare Bash command contract with live execution

prd_items.acceptance: A live GM literal codesearch response retains mode literal and declares exhaustive true or a named bound/error.
prd_items.subject: Repair the confirmed GM codesearch defect where a `{mode:"literal"}` request returns `mode:"dual"` and omits `exhaustive:true`. Precondition: the served GM contract promises literal tree-read exhaustive results. Invariant: a requested search mode is never silently downgraded. Postcondition: literal mode returns every tree match with `exhaustive:true`, or a truthful explicit bounded/error state.
prd_items.title: Make GM literal code search honor its exhaustive contract

prd_items.acceptance: A real Freddie Bash invocation in danger-full-access mode completes without requesting sandbox escalation, while narrower modes retain only strictly-wider escalation behavior.
prd_items.subject: Trace and repair Freddie’s Bash invocation policy that sends sandbox escalation while the current session already has danger-full-access.
prd_items.title: Omit redundant Bash sandbox escalation

prd_items.acceptance: Current branch incorporates upstream or reports a concrete merge blocker.
prd_items.subject: Fetch every configured remote and merge its upstream mainline before local implementation.
prd_items.title: Integrate remote state

prd_items.acceptance: The agentplug host's real host_fs_stat output includes a non-null canonicalPath for a symlinked workspace directory and scan_deps uses that identity to avoid revisiting it.
prd_items.subject: The workspace scanner requires host_stat canonicalPath values to deduplicate directories reached through pnpm symlinks; confirm the host ABI returns a canonical resolved directory path for valid links.
prd_items.title: Expose canonical paths from host stat

prd_items.acceptance: Actual grammar/parser are traced; bare multiline Bash execution and served guidance agree; a manual live command witnesses the final behavior.
prd_items.subject: Diagnose the served Bash plain-text grammar and runtime parser, then make a bare multiline Bash script execute with a documented default timeout or otherwise align wording with enforced input.
prd_items.title: Align bare Bash timeout semantics

prd_items.acceptance: Instruction reporting derives code-insight overview without unknown_plugin when libsql is absent, and a live Freddie instruction dispatch demonstrates the explicit unavailable state.
prd_items.subject: The live instruction response reports codeinsight_overview.counts_error unknown_plugin because overview calls the optional libsql plugin with no availability guard.
prd_items.title: Repair missing code-insight plugin dependency

## Resolved mutable: browser-shell-hmr-live-protocol

Read-only source evidence: client HMR EventSource uses /plugins/events at packages/client/hmr/src/client/index.js:213-227; host registers and emits it at packages/client/hmr/src/index.js:265-331. Non-mutating GUI observation at http://127.0.0.1:3080 confirmed __FREDDIE_BOOT__.rev=796f14b10061 and shell script /src/main.js.

## Resolved mutable: audit-path-completeness

Exhaustive source trace read: packages/core/agent-loop/src/tool-calls.js:36-266; packages/core/tools/src/index.js:500-1324; packages/jobs/tool-jobs/src/index.js:160-357; packages/jobs/jobs-local/src/index.js:90-238,375-399; packages/gm/gm-client/src/spool.js:117-238; packages/session/session-checkpoint-policy/src/index.js:54-73; packages/session/session-persistence/src/write-behind.js:37-149 and coordinator.js:919-1017. Findings distinguish normal ordered barriers from improvement candidates.

## Resolved mutable: hmr-runtime-path

Read-only source audit found host HMR is framework/hmr/src/index.js and the separate browser reload chain is package freddie-client-hmr mounted by packages/bundle/web-app/cordis.patch.yml:142-147; browser transport is outside framework HMR.

## Resolved mutable: audit-scan-blocks

Repeated frozen-lockfile installs completed, but scan_deps still reports 3 blocked reads only on an absurdly recursive node_modules @freddie/Cordis path, with failCount 0 and nodeModulesTruncated false; this remains an environment graph integrity defect, not evidence of malicious code.

## Resolved mutable: tooling-latency-witness

Read-only source evidence established candidate sources, not a live timing measurement: client poll/hash duplication at packages/client/hmr/src/index.js:73-187 and packages/client/modules/src/index.js:124-160; serial preflight at packages/core/agent-loop/src/tool-calls.js:175-206; gm poll metadata work at packages/gm/gm-client/src/spool.js:174-193. User requested audit only with no changes; live measurement is specified as the implementation verification gate.
